message.reasoning_content: All three probe results available. Finalize each: c1 E=0.079 <= 0.12 → rebutted (claim was that E may exceed; measured E below). c2: level_mismatch_count 0, no extra error beyond scale/2 → rebutted. Note: "max_elem_levels_distinct_from_7" = 16 — hmm, that's because I used abs(w[i]) argmax but max|w| may be negative; actually 16 rows where the max-abs element's level isn't ±7. That's because argmax over abs returns first max abs index; if max abs element is negative, its level is -7, not 7 — my check compared to 7.0 not 7 sign-adjusted. So that metric is buggy, but level_mismatch_count=0 and exceeds_bound=false are the decisive metrics: the float32 quantizer matches float64 exactly on all 4096 elements and max error ≤ scale/2. c3: finite → rebutted.
